name: zpp_bits (evidence update)
workload: Same graph serialize/deserialize/traverse benchmark as the Cista++ entry (nodes+edges, Google Benchmark), comparing zpp_bits against Cap'n Proto, cereal, Cista++, and FlatBuffers.
claimed_speedup: ~5.4x faster deserialize than FlatBuffers (6.58ms vs 35.7ms) and ~1.15x faster traverse (65ms vs 75ms); 1.7x smaller serialized size (37.8MB vs 63.0MB) (derived from page data)
tradeoffs: Header-only, C++20-only; no cross-language codegen like FlatBuffers/Protobuf
caveats: Same benchmark also shows a raw serialize number (4ms vs FlatBuffers 1409ms, ~350x) that looks implausible for the reasons noted in the Cista++ entry and was excluded from the headline claim. zpp_bits is already on the known-list; this is new Tier A third-party-repo evidence (independent of zpp_bits' own author) found while researching this category, hence is_evidence_for_known=true.
found_via: GitHub: opened felixguendling/cpp-serialization-benchmark README while evaluating Cista++
